protocol.matchedBinding: Frozen baseline benchmark and dependency assemblies; only OfficeIMO.Excel DLL/PDB swapped.
protocol.validation: Complete owned-string CSV and fourteen-column typed workbook observations checked before timing; measured workbook methods also validate their observations.
protocol.currentReaderMethodOrder: One fixed declared BenchmarkDotNet method order per cache domain; no randomized or counterbalanced library order. Small differences are not ranking or equivalence evidence.

notes: Ordinary host load retained. Controls range from3percent faster to8.6percent slower; single launch per source/domain, not an equivalence test or whole-market claim.

The initial XLSB legs ran at High priority and are excluded. All eight XLSB rows here are matched Normal-priority replacements, with the same optional priority setup applied to the benchmark harness. Only benchmark DLL/PDB changed for that replacement.
Allocation readings vary materially in some matched/control processes. Preserve per-process values; do not infer an allocation improvement from unlike noisy legs.
XLSB replacements retain start/end load observations; intermediate host CPU samples are unavailable.
FourLambda AVX2 scanner selected on this host. PRIME uses the managed forward-only reader and default/style conversion.
Owned timing/sampling processes exited. Detached checkouts and task build/runtime/fixture outputs removed;2,741,630,351logical bytes removed, compact original evidence retained.
In particular, CSV20.978ms versus20.544ms is descriptive only: fixed method order and host drift prevent a leader/equivalence claim from this close pair.
sourceHeadMeaning: Measured product and ordinary current harness source. XLSB Normal recheck uses the exact recorded source patch below on this revision; it is not an unmodified checkout.

matchedXlsx.overlay: Only OfficeIMO.Excel.dll and PDB built from sourceHead; exact observed binary bindings retained.

xlsbNormalRecheck.overlay: Only benchmark DLL/PDB replaced relative to the current workbook runtime. Product and comparison binaries unchanged.

reproduction.executable: dotnet.exe resolved separately by the launcher; SDK/runtime identities retained in host.
reproduction.argumentListSemantics: Saved Windows PowerShell Start-Process ArgumentList arrays. Literal quotes around the artifact-path entry delimit the Windows command line; a native argv API passes that path without those quote characters.
reproduction.affinity: Launcher set its ProcessorAffinity before starting timing children; live timing-process samples verified effective masks. Launcher started at Normal; benchmark setup reapplied optional process priority. Original mixed workbook runs contain discarded High-priority XLSB legs; accepted XLSX and replacement XLSB phases run Normal.
reproduction.environmentLimit: These variables are explicitly recorded in retained scripts; a complete inherited environment was not captured.
